text:
maria: FYI seeing a spike in NVMe queue_depth on sandbox-pool nodes since ~23:40 UTC, GPU attach latency is rising. Anyone digging?
sam: Seeing p95 attach ~4.2s, some nodes hit queue_depth >1024. Might be scrub overlap + lots of small writes.
jia: Link: https://grafana.redwood/graph?panel=nvme_queue&s=sandbox — read stalls + metadata ops jump :thinking_face:
diego: Could be overlayfs dentry growth after yesterday's rollback. Noticed increased dentry count on a few nodes.
maria: Quick sample from iostat (one noisy host):
```
Device            r/s     w/s   rkB/s   wkB/s  avwait
nvme0n1         8.00  300.00   64.0  4096.0   12.3
```
sam: Also seeing massive tmpfile churn under /tmp/sandbox from CI harness. Tests create many tiny files concurrently.
sre-bot: Alert: nvme_queue_depth_high on sandbox-pool (avg=820) — incident INC-4282 created.
jia: Short mitigation idea: reduce concurrent attaches to the pool and lower janitor scrub throughput during peaks. Can we set a smaller scratch quota label on a canary set? @kubebot set node.k8s.redwood/sandbox-scratch-quota=0.3 on 3 nodes?
diego: I'll cordon the top-3 noisy nodes and drain GPU pods off them: `kubectl cordon gnode-ps-03` then `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets` — doing now.
maria: Before cordon, let's try dropping janitor throughput on canary: `janitor.scrub_rate=0.2` to reduce background IO and avoid wear spikes.
sam: Patching config for canary janitors now:
```
kubectl patch cm janitor-config -n infra --type merge -p '{"data":{"scrub_rate":"0.2"}}'
```
diego: Cordon done, evictions started. Early signal: gpu-scheduler attach p95 dropped to ~1.6s on the canary nodes.
jia: Filed sandbox/CI-73 to throttle parallel writers in the test harness so it doesn't hammer temp storage.
maria: Longer-term followup: implement peak-window janitor throttles + add temporary extra scratch NVMe capacity for heavy launch windows (>200/min). Putting this into infra backlog.
sam: I'll run capacity sims and estimate cost delta for adding scratch throughput vs. throttling.
sre-bot: INC-4282 status=mitigated. followup: root_cause_candidate=overlayfs-dentry-leak + high-tempfile-churn.
diego: We should add a per-node dentry/overlayfs probe to alert earlier. Also consider a short-term policy to limit per-pod small-file IO.
maria: Agreed. Thanks all. Will track action items in INC-4282 and open a small RFC for scrub-throttles. :thumbsup:
